question: Narmada Bachao Andolan is related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Sarovar Dam**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Narmada Bachao Andolan is the most powerful mass movement, started in 1985, against the construction of a huge** dam on the Narmada river**.
 
• Narmada Bachao Andolan (NBA) is an Indian social movement initiated by native tribals (Adivasis), farmers, environmentalists, and human rights activists. The river flows through the states of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra. 
 
• Sardar Sarovar is the project related to Narmada Bachao Andolan.
 
• Medha Patkar and Baba Amte are associated with Narmada Bachao Andolan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Narmada is the largest **west flowing **peninsular river in India.
 
• Narmada river originates from Amarkantak Plateau, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It drains into the Arabian Sea through the Gulf of Khambhat.
 
• Major tributaries of the Narmada river are:
 
 
• Hiran river.
 
• Tendoni river.
 
• Kolar river.
 
• Hatni river.
 
• Orsang river.
 
• Tawa river.
 
• Barna river.
